SEOUL 3D ATLAS — DATA AND SOFTWARE ATTRIBUTIONS

Map geometry and buildings: © OpenStreetMap contributors, made available through OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles.
OpenStreetMap data is available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0:
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
This derived map database is offered under ODbL 1.0 as well. The processed vector snapshot is 2026-08-30.
Download /data/seoul.json, /data/buildings.bin and /data/trails.json to obtain the derived data.
The binary building format is little-endian float32: [x_km, z_km, width_km, depth_km, angle_radians, height_m], repeated for each building.
Projection origin and coordinate scale are in seoul.json meta. Building heights can be source estimates; footprints are simplified oriented boxes.

District boundary source: southkorea/seoul-maps / Statistics Korea (KOSTAT), 2013.
https://github.com/southkorea/seoul-maps
Historical boundaries are shown as optional reference boundaries.

Elevation: Mapzen / AWS Terrain Tiles.
Global ETOPO1 terrain data: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
Global GMTED2010 and SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/
https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
Elevation is smoothed, shorelines are flattened for display, and vertical scale is exaggerated by 4.

Hiking overlay v1.7: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
Source: Overpass API snapshot 2026-09-08T05:36:51Z.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://overpass-api.de/
Coverage: longitude 126.70–127.35, latitude 37.25–37.85.
804 mapped peaks, 13,719 mountain walking/hiking way sections, 1,595 computed
connected summit approaches. Coordinates and way IDs are retained in trails.json.
Sections are geographically grouped around peaks; groups overlap. Public path,
footway, steps and track ways are filtered by mountain proximity and elevation.
Private/prohibited, conditional-access, informal and area features are excluded.
Summit approaches are shortest paths along connected mapped pedestrian edges,
not official designated courses. Start/finish markers identify actual polyline
endpoints. A connection may end near a summit rather than at the peak node.
Mapped distance is horizontal polyline length, not an on-site measurement.
Unmapped trails, changes, hazards and live access restrictions are not complete.
Additional outer terrain/water uses the same attributed elevation/vector sources.


APARTMENT DATA — v2.0
Seoul Metropolitan Government, Seoul Open Data Plaza.
Apartment sale records: https://data.seoul.go.kr/dataList/OA-21275/S/1/datasetView.do
Apartment catalog / coordinates: https://data.seoul.go.kr/dataList/OA-15818/S/1/datasetView.do
Both datasets: Korea Open Government License Type 1 (Attribution), commercial use and modification allowed.
Downloaded 2026-09-08. Data transformed into compact district partitions; selected catalog fields only.
See data/apartments/provenance.json for exact source counts and SHA-256 hashes.
The snapshot contains no owner, buyer, seller, phone, or apartment unit numbers.
